hostNotes: Accept any gazetted town or locality in regional Victoria, including regional cities (Geelong, Ballarat, Bendigo) and alpine resort villages (Mount Buller, Falls Creek, Mount Hotham); spelling is forgiving, so match phonetically, and a town not in this bank is still correct if it exists (verify quickly and treat it as a deep cut). Yarra Valley and fringe townships (Healesville, Warburton, Gembrook, Koo Wee Rup, Whittlesea) sit inside the Greater Melbourne boundary but are universally treated as country towns, so accept them; Mornington Peninsula towns (Sorrento, Rye, Flinders) and outer suburbs (Sunbury, Melton, Pakenham, Werribee, Cranbourne) are the host's call, lean reject. Traps: Albury, Moama, Corowa, Mulwala, Barooga, Tocumwal and Deniliquin are NSW and Mount Gambier is SA, so reject them; 'Phillip Island', 'the Grampians', 'the Otways' and 'Wilsons Prom' are regions, not towns, so ask for a town (Cowes, Halls Gap, Apollo Bay, Foster).
